_doc: Per-fixture node-size ratchet for the state DOT-parity suite (decisions.md#d4, A4). Same convention as oracle/goldens/object/size-backlog.json: structurally EQUAL fixtures whose maxSizeDeltaIn (inches, max across their svek-N graphs) is not yet 0; the test asserts delta <= pinned + 1e-6 per graph, so deltas only shrink. Phase L size iterations drive entries to 0 and DELETE them (absent slug = 0 required). Captured 2026-07-11 at ratchet creation. skin-loading B2 note (nimana-36-veco708): the G8 tracked exception is RESOLVED. The skin-file-loading mission landed `skin <name>` stylesheet loading + state drop-shadow rendering/ink (skin rose Shadowing=4.0 now draws the filter and reserves 2*shadow=8px), so this entry improved 0.111111 -> 0.043169 (below its pre-G8 0.090278). The remaining 0.043169 is a pre-existing NON-shadow size gap on another svek graph of this fixture (a separate size-parity follow-up, not skin/shadow), pinned tighten-only here. INHERENT-TOLERANCE EXCLUSIONS (added 2026-08-10): corumi-91-mizo869 and gupeto-19-mesa256 are NOT defects and must not be driven to 0. Both carry the same <math>S<=1/(F+(1-F)/N)</math> label and both pin at the identical 1.106597, the signature of one shared inherent cause: <math> renders through KaTeX where the jar uses JLaTeXMath, a PERMANENT maintainer-approved divergence (DIVERGENCES.md, 'LaTeX rendering engine'). They stay pinned shrink-only for non-regression but are excluded from the conformant denominator, exactly as the description suite treats gevozu-46/sunuju-01. Before this note the state backlog had NO divergence language at all, so these two read as ordinary work items.
